sqlMap.select: SELECT NVL(A.LEGACY_PO_NO,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_NO, NVL(TO_CHAR(A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ,'FM0000'),' ') AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, NVL(B.ITEM_QTY,0) AS GR_QTY, NVL(B.GR_DATE,' ') AS GR_DATE, NVL(DECODE(A.PROCESS_TYPE,'0',(SELECT MAX(COD1.TEXT1) FROM ICOMIVDT IVDT, ICOMIVHD IVHD, ICOMCOD1 COD1 WHERE IVDT.BUYER = B.BUYER AND IVDT.PO_NO = B.PO_NO AND IVDT.PO_SEQ= B.PO_SEQ AND IVDT.INV_NO= B.INV_NO AND IVDT.INV_SEQ=B.INV_SEQ AND IVDT.BUYER = IVHD.BUYER AND IVDT.INV_NO= IVHD.INV_NO AND IVHD.PARCEL_COM_CODE = COD1.CODE AND COD1.TYPE = 'C019'), (SELECT MAX(COD1.TEXT1) FROM WMSIVDT IVDT, ICOMCOD1 COD1 WHERE IVDT.BUYER = B.BUYER AND IVDT.PO_NO = B.PO_NO AND IVDT.PO_SEQ= B.PO_SEQ AND IVDT.INV_NO= B.INV_NO AND IVDT.INV_SEQ=B.INV_SEQ AND IVDT.DELIVERY_COMPANY = COD1.CODE AND COD1.TYPE = 'C019')),'자체배송') AS DELIVERY_COMPANY, NVL(DECODE(A.PROCESS_TYPE,'0',(SELECT MAX(IVHD.PARCEL_INV_NO) FROM ICOMIVDT IVDT, ICOMIVHD IVHD WHERE IVDT.BUYER = B.BUYER AND IVDT.PO_NO = B.PO_NO AND IVDT.PO_SEQ= B.PO_SEQ AND IVDT.INV_NO= B.INV_NO AND IVDT.INV_SEQ=B.INV_SEQ AND IVDT.BUYER = IVHD.BUYER AND IVDT.INV_NO= IVHD.INV_NO), (SELECT MAX(IVDT.DELIVERY_NO) FROM WMSIVDT IVDT WHERE IVDT.BUYER = B.BUYER AND IVDT.PO_NO = B.PO_NO AND IVDT.PO_SEQ= B.PO_SEQ AND IVDT.INV_NO= B.INV_NO AND IVDT.INV_SEQ=B.INV_SEQ)),' ') AS DELIVERY_NO, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS CUR_DATATIME, B.GR_NO FROM ICOMPODT A, ICOMGRDT B WHERE B.BUYER = #TARGET# AND B.GR_NO = #KEY_1# AND B.BUYER = A.BUYER AND B.PO_NO = A.PO_NO AND B.PO_SEQ = A.PO_SEQ AND A.STATUS != 'D' AND B.STATUS != 'D'
